## De-risking complete — scope split (safe vs risky) + execution plan

Verified across **framework + objectui + cloud + hotcrm + templates** (BSD-grep caveat: must use `[[:space:]]`, not `\s`; control `label:` = 9887 confirms the grep works):

**Every dead candidate is set 0× and read 0× in configs/UI across all repos.** So removal breaks no *config*. The real risk is **spec's own tests** + TS read-access — and that splits the set cleanly:

### ✅ Safe to remove (unique names, findable test footprint)
- **field**: `vectorConfig` (+`VectorConfigSchema`+types), `fileAttachmentConfig` (+`FileAttachmentConfigSchema`+types), `maxRating`, `caseSensitive`, `referenceFilters` — test footprint only in `field.test.ts`/`widget.test.ts` (vectorConfig + fileAttachmentConfig have whole `describe` blocks to delete; maxRating/caseSensitive trivial; referenceFilters = 2 fixture lines).
- **object**: `partitioning`, `softDelete`, `recordName`, `keyPrefix`, `defaultDetailForm` (+ their sub-schemas) — 0–1 spec test files.
- **dataset**: `measures.certified`.
- **agent**: `tenantId` — *findable in agent.zod but the NAME is overloaded in tests* (see risky).

### ⚠️ Risky — DO NOT bulk-remove (names overloaded; can't separate spec-prop test usage from noise)
`field.index`, `field.columnName`, `field.dependencies`, `object.versioning`, `object.tags`, `object.active`, `object.abstract`, `object.isSystem`, `object.search`, `object.enable.*` (trackHistory/searchable/files/feeds/activities/trash/mru), `agent.tenantId`, `action.timeout`.
- `dependencies` 18 test files, `versioning` 8, `tenantId` 21, `tags` 26, `active` 21, `search` 9, `index` 5 — almost all unrelated (package deps, storage versioning, tenant context, array index, full-text search). Removing risks breaking tests that can't be reliably located.
- These are **unenforced but harmless**; recommend either leaving them or handling each with per-occurrence inspection in a dedicated pass — NOT worth the blast radius in a batch.

### Recommended execution
Per-area PRs for the **safe** set only (field → object → dataset), each: remove zod prop + sub-schema + type exports → update `packages/spec/liveness/<type>.json` → delete the matching test cases → `gen:api-surface` → full `vitest run` in spec (not just the file). Leave the overloaded-name props.

**First batch landed → #2402 (merged).** Removed the truly-trivial, zero-non-spec-footprint dead props: **field** `caseSensitive`, `maxRating`; **object** `partitioning` (+`PartitioningConfigSchema`), `defaultDetailForm`. Ledgers + api-surface updated; spec 6595 + Test Core + liveness all green.

**Lesson / scope refinement:** `softDelete` and `measures.certified` were in my 'safe' list but turned out to be **set in non-spec test fixtures** (mcp; analytics ×7) → Test Core went red; both **deferred** (need fixture migration). So the remaining #2377 work = those two + the overloaded-name set (`tags`/`active`/`versioning`/`dependencies`/`index`/`columnName`/`enable.*`/`agent.tenantId`/`action.timeout`). Reconfirms: **for spec-prop removal, grep ALL package tests (not just spec) for set-usage before removing.**

**Re-evaluation + next slice → #3176 (draft).**

Re-audited the remaining dead set against the current liveness ledgers on `main`. Findings that update the earlier triage:

- The "overloaded-name / hard to grep" blocker is **gone**: every dead prop now carries a `status: dead` + evidence entry in `packages/spec/liveness/*.json`, so removal no longer depends on grepping ambiguous names.
- The real remaining gate is **the Studio metadata-authoring forms** (`*.form.ts`) + their generated i18n bundles. Many dead props are *surfaced in the authoring form*, so removing them cascades into i18n regeneration — those are deferred as a coordinated follow-up.

### Removed in #3176 (dead **and** not surfaced in any authoring form → self-contained)
- **field**: `vectorConfig`, `fileAttachmentConfig`, `dependencies`
- **object**: `versioning`, `softDelete`, `search`, `recordName`, `keyPrefix` (+ sub-schemas; each now a rejecting tombstone in `UNKNOWN_KEY_GUIDANCE`)
- **action**: `timeout`
- **agent**: `planning.strategy`, `planning.allowReplan` (keep `planning.maxIterations`)
- **dataset**: `measures.certified`

Ledgers + README table + `api-surface.json` + `json-schema.manifest.json` updated; fixtures migrated (analytics/rest/lint/cli). Spec **6875** green, liveness gate ✓, api-surface ✓. Cuts **16.0.0** (major changeset).

### Deferred (dead, but entangled — need a follow-up)
- **Authoring-form-surfaced** (removal ⇒ i18n bundle regen): field `index`/`columnName`/`referenceFilters`; object `tags`/`active`/`isSystem`/`abstract`/`enable.searchable`/`enable.trash`/`enable.mru`; agent `tenantId`.
- **`action.type:'form'`** — has a dedicated build-time lint (`lint-view-refs.ts`) + a first-party `app-showcase` action; removing it needs a UX decision (what the "Log Time" action becomes), not a mechanical strip.
- **`field.columnName`** — additionally referenced by the ADR-0062 D7 external-object lint (whose comment frames it as the "managed-object mechanism", contradicting the ledger's `dead`), so it needs an owner call, not a sweep.

All deferred entries stay `dead` + `authorWarn` so authors still get the build-time warning. Note: several items in the original issue body are **already LIVE** and must not be removed — `enable.trackHistory/files/feeds/activities` (plugin-audit enforced) and `agent.planning.maxIterations`.

**Final slice → #3414 (draft). This closes out the A2 removal scope; the issue auto-closes on merge.**

Full disposition of the original set across the three waves (#2402 → #3176 → #3414):

### Removed
- **field**: `caseSensitive`, `maxRating` (#2402); `vectorConfig`, `fileAttachmentConfig`, `dependencies` (#3176); `index`, `columnName`, `referenceFilters` (follow-up slice — the ADR-0062 D7 `columnName` lint conflict resolved by removing lint + field together; external column mapping is `external.columnMap`)
- **object**: `partitioning`, `defaultDetailForm` (#2402); `versioning`, `softDelete`, `search`, `recordName`, `keyPrefix` (#3176, tombstoned in `UNKNOWN_KEY_GUIDANCE`); `tags`, `active`, `abstract` (follow-up slice); **`enable.trash`, `enable.mru` (#3414 — `ObjectCapabilities` now `.strict()` with retired-key tombstones; ~46 first-party setters cleaned; docs/skills stop advertising a recycle bin)**
- **action**: `timeout` (#3176)
- **agent**: `tenantId` (follow-up slice); `planning.strategy`, `planning.allowReplan` (#3176)
- **dataset**: `measures.certified` (#3176)

### Reclassified LIVE — kept (2026-06 audit misses, correctness fixes to this issue's original list)
- `object.isSystem` (plugin-sharing `effectiveSharingModel` default), `enable.searchable` (global-search opt-out), `enable.trackHistory`/`files`/`feeds`/`activities` (plugin-audit enforced), `action.type:'form'` (objectui `ActionRunner.executeForm` — enforce won over remove; also fixed "Log Time does nothing"), `agent.planning.maxIterations`, `field.currencyConfig`, `object.apiEnabled`, `action.disabled`/`shortcut`/`bulkEnabled`, `agent.access`/`permissions`, `skill.triggerPhrases`/`permissions`.

### Result
`packages/spec/liveness/object.json` (and field/action/agent/dataset) now carry **0 dead entries** in this issue's scope. Remaining aspirational-config work for other types (theme, translation, webhook, portal, …) stays tracked in #1893.

Bonus from #3414's `.strict()`: two latent unknown-key bugs surfaced immediately — `sys_secret` and `sys_setting_audit` had been authoring a never-existent `enable.audit` flag, silently stripped until now.
